benefits.text: hince True Dimension Glow Cheek supple powder blush has a light, supple powder that melts smoothly onto skin, in refined shades that accent the cheekbones. The texture glides on lightly without feeling heavy or stuffy on the skin, and without making the base slide off or break up. Creates a highlighting effect for beautifully shimmering cheeks.

howToUse.text:
Apply with fingers: Use your fingertips to apply for a natural finish
Apply with a brush: Use a brush and blend evenly for a thin, light, light-catching layer and captivating, shimmering cheeks.
Can be used as blush, highlighter and eyeshadow, and on lips too.

safety.text:
For external use on the cheeks only; avoid use on scratched or irritated skin
Discontinue use if any unusual signs appear, and keep out of reach of children.

sellingPoints.text: Light, supple powder that melts smoothly onto skin; doesn't feel heavy or stuffy; can be used multi-purpose on cheeks, for highlighting, on eyes and on lips.

positioning.text: A soft, smooth supple powder blush that gives a fresh, natural cheek color with a subtle highlighting effect.

texture.text: Soft, smooth supple powder that glides lightly over skin.

finish.text: Glow cheek / natural flush / subtle highlight.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it never makes the base slide off under any circumstances. When used on lips, describe it only as multi-use per the documentation, not as a replacement for a dedicated lipstick.
